verdict.rationale: Drata's help center appears to serve an llms.txt file (drata-docs-26 shows a help.drata.com/llms.txt entry), but direct probes of the developer docs site show no llms.txt, no markdown-alternative docs, and no discoverable OpenAPI spec (drata-probe-1, drata-probe-2, drata-probe-3), meaning the primary API/developer documentation is not agent-consumable in a structured way. Missing for 10: a working llms.txt or machine-readable docs on developers.drata.com, an accessible OpenAPI/swagger spec, and any first-party guidance on pointing agents at these docs.
